say:1:1110615001:1.text: To defeat such a formidable foe—

say:2:1110615002:0.text: Could they truly have the salt to take home the Warsong Festival crown?
say:2:1110615002:0.source_cn: 难道他们真的有机会摘取战歌节的桂冠？让我们以热烈的掌声...

say:4:1110615003:1.text: Excellent! You truly are worthy adversaries. I approve! I enjoy this kind of fight.
say:4:1110615003:1.source_cn: 好！你们称得上是我沙奎尔的强敌！我喜欢这样的战斗。

say:5:1110615004:1.text: My fighting spirit swells with pride for you young Mauler cubs. I'm already eager for another scrap...
say:5:1110615004:1.source_cn: 我的战意又燃起来了，不愧是你认可的蛮血。磨练再度召唤了我……

say:6:1110615005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!
say:6:1110615005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!
say:6:1110615005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!

choice_prompt:7:1110615005.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!
choice_prompt:7:1110615005.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!
choice_prompt:7:1110615005.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!

say:8:1110615006:0.text: The only way I'll lose is if I forget to show up.

say:9:1110615008:1.text: Now, everyone! These next two will go toe-to-toe in what's sure to be the Sunseek Arena's most exciting match yet!
say:9:1110615008:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们！残阳武斗场最激动人心的表演赛——

say:10:1110615009:1.text: This is the last festival's champion versus the runner-up—Brutus vs. Orson!
say:10:1110615009:1.source_cn: 上一届的冠亚军！布鲁特斯对阵奥格，即将开场！

say:13:1110615011:1.text: But Brutus is about to take on Orson! We've got nothing else for the moment, so why not go and watch?
say:13:1110615011:1.source_cn: 那可是布鲁特斯大人打那个奥格的比赛诶！我们现在又没有赛...

say:14:1110615012:1.text: I didn't say I wouldn't. Can you slow down?
say:14:1110615012:1.source_cn: 没说不去。你就不能稍微慢点？

say:15:1110615013:1.text: There are too many people! If we slow down, we won't make it to the front! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay close to us!
say:15:1110615013:1.source_cn: 人太多了！慢点就挤不到前排了！<style=stres...
say:15:1110615013:1.male: There are too many people! If we slow down, we won't make it to the front! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay close to us!
say:15:1110615013:1.female: There are too many people! If we slow down, we won't make it to the front! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay close to us!

say:16:1110615014:1.text: I'm going to use my trademark move "Boulder Dash" to clear a path!
say:16:1110615014:1.source_cn: 我要使出滚团开路的绝招了！

say:17:1110615015:1.text: ...Isn't that when you just roll in a ball? Alsa, wait for us!
say:17:1110615015:1.source_cn: ……不就是团成一团滚过去，喂，阿尔萨，慢点！

say:18:1110615016:1.text: Keep up! It's about to start!
say:18:1110615016:1.source_cn: 快跟上啊！马上就开场了！

say:20:1110615007:1.text: I will take that as a yes.
say:20:1110615007:1.male: I will take that as a yes.
say:20:1110615007:1.female: I will take that as a yes.
